slides.text: VectorMapNet makes three contributions. It predicts vectorized outputs directly from sensors, with no rasterization or post-processing. slides.heading: Method
slides.text: VectorMapNet has three stages. A bird's-eye-view extractor maps each modality into a shared space: cameras through a ResNet and IPM, LiDAR through PointPillars, fused by concatenation. A detection transformer with element queries locates each element as keypoints. An autoregressive polyline generator then emits ordered vertices, trained with detection and generation losses.
